_comment: Human-readable/editable mirror of the whitelist enforced in src/laptop_copilot/tools.py. Editing this file alone does NOT add new capabilities — it documents and can disable existing ones via 'enabled'.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Launch an installed application by name.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a quick note in the notes directory.

tools.name: show_recent_files
tools.description: List recently modified/opened files in Downloads, Documents, Desktop.

tools.name: open_last_file
tools.description: Open the most recently used/downloaded file.

tools.name: open_calendar
tools.description: Open a calendar application (read-only in v1).

tools.name: show_clipboard
tools.description: Show or search current clipboard contents.
